parts.label: a
hints: Consult the 'Critical values for the normal distribution' table at the bottom of the Cambridge MF19 formula sheet.
Look up the cumulative probability $p = 0.90$ to find the corresponding standard normal value $z$.

walkthrough.text:
Locate the cumulative probability $p = 0.90$ in the critical values table:
$$\Phi(z) = 0.90$$

Read the corresponding value of $z$ directly from the table:
$$z = 1.282$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Identify that the cumulative area is 0.90, which lies above the median (0.5), indicating a positive $z$-score:
$$\Phi(z) = 0.90 \implies z > 0$$

Extract the critical value from the formula sheet table:
$$z = 1.282$$

ai_rubric.observable: Locate cumulative probability 0.90 in the critical values section of the normal table.
Identify the standard normal score z = 1.282.

parts.label: a
hints: Since the cumulative area is $0.10 < 0.50$, the boundary lies to the left of the mean, meaning $z$ must be negative.
By symmetry, the magnitude of $z$ is the same as for an upper tail of $0.10$ (where cumulative area is $0.90$): find $z = -1.282$.

walkthrough.text:
Recognise that a cumulative area of 0.10 is in the lower tail below the mean:
$$\text{P}(Z < z) = 0.10 < 0.50 \implies z < 0$$

Apply symmetry with the upper tail area $\text{P}(Z > |z|) = 0.10 \implies \Phi(|z|) = 0.90$:
$$|z| = 1.282 \implies z = -1.282$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Use the reflection property of the standard normal curve:
$$\text{P}(Z < z) = 1 - \Phi(-z) = 0.10 \implies \Phi(-z) = 0.90$$

Read the positive critical value and attach the negative sign:
$$-z = 1.282 \implies z = -1.282$$

ai_rubric.observable: Recognise lower tail area 0.10 by symmetry with upper tail 1 - 0.90 = 0.10.
State the negative standard normal score z = -1.282.

parts.label: a
hints: First convert the upper tail probability into a cumulative probability: $\text{P}(Z < z) = 1 - \text{P}(Z > z) = 1 - 0.12 = 0.88$.
Search the main body of the standard normal table for a probability of $0.8800$ to find the corresponding $z$ value.

walkthrough.text:
Convert the upper tail probability to cumulative area:
$$\Phi(z) = 1 - \text{P}(Z > z) = 1 - 0.12 = 0.8800$$

Look up 0.8800 in the normal distribution table:
$$\Phi(1.17) = 0.8790, \quad \text{difference } = 10 \implies \text{add-column } 5 \implies z = 1.175$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Express the given tail condition in terms of the standard cdf $\Phi$:
$$\Phi(z) = 1 - 0.12 = 0.88$$

Read the inverse normal value from the MF19 tables:
$$z = 1.175$$

ai_rubric.observable: Convert upper tail probability to cumulative area P(Z < z) = 1 - 0.12 = 0.88.
Read the standard normal value z = 1.175.

parts.label: a
hints: Notice that $\text{P}(Z > z) = 0.75 > 0.50$, which means the boundary $z$ must lie below 0 (negative).
The cumulative probability is $\text{P}(Z < z) = 1 - 0.75 = 0.25$. Since $\Phi(0.674) = 0.75$, deduce that $z = -0.674$.

walkthrough.text:
Find the cumulative probability to the left of $z$:
$$\text{P}(Z < z) = 1 - \text{P}(Z > z) = 1 - 0.75 = 0.25$$

Identify the upper quartile value from the critical values table and reflect:
$$\Phi(0.674) = 0.75 \implies z = -0.674$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Observe that if 75% of values exceed $z$, $z$ must be the lower quartile:
$$\text{P}(Z < z) = 0.25$$

Read the critical value for $p = 0.75$ and negate it:
$$z = -0.674$$

ai_rubric.observable: Convert to cumulative area P(Z < z) = 1 - 0.75 = 0.25 and identify reflection symmetry.
Look up Phi(0.674) = 0.75 to state the negative score z = -0.674.

parts.label: a
hints: Use the rearrangement of the standardisation formula: $x = \mu + z\sigma$.
Substitute $\mu = 50$, $\sigma = 4$, and $z = 1.282$.

walkthrough.text:
State the relationship between $x$ and $z$:
$$x = \mu + z\sigma = 50 + 1.282 \times 4$$

Calculate the numerical value:
$$x = 50 + 5.128 = 55.128 \approx 55.1$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Unstandardise the score by multiplying by the standard deviation and adding the mean:
$$x = 50 + 4(1.282)$$

Compute the boundary:
$$x = 55.128$$

ai_rubric.observable: Set up unstandardisation equation x = mu + z * sigma: 50 + 1.282 * 4.
Evaluate the expression to obtain x = 55.128 (or 55.1).

ai_rubric.observable: Set up unstandardisation equation x = mu + z * sigma: 100 + (-0.674) * 15.

parts.label: a
hints: Convert the upper tail $\text{P}(X > c) = 0.12$ into a cumulative probability: $\text{P}(X < c) = 1 - 0.12 = 0.88$.

teacher_walkthrough.text:

ai_rubric.observable: Find cumulative area 1 - 0.12 = 0.88 and lookup z = 1.175 to form (c - 52.0) / 7.0 = 1.175.

parts.label: b
hints: Since $\text{P}(X < d) = 0.12$ is a lower tail of 0.12, by symmetry $z = -1.175$.

walkthrough.text:

parts.label: a
hints: 'Takes more than $t_1$' means $\text{P}(T > t_1) = 0.90$, so the cumulative probability is $\text{P}(T < t_1) = 0.10$.

walkthrough.text:
Translate the condition into cumulative area and deduce the $z$-score:
$$\text{P}(T > t_1) = 0.90 \implies \text{P}(T < t_1) = 0.10 \implies z = -1.282$$

Solve for $t_1$ using the standardisation formula:
$$\frac{t_1 - 68.0}{5.0} = -1.282 \implies t_1 = 68.0 - 5.0 \times 1.282 = 61.59 \approx 61.6\text{ minutes}$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Recognise that if 90% of times exceed $t_1$, $t_1$ lies in the 10th percentile:
$$z = -1.282$$

Calculate the time boundary:
$$t_1 = 68 - 5(1.282) = 61.6\text{ minutes}$$

ai_rubric.observable: Convert P(T > t_1) = 0.90 to cumulative area P(T < t_1) = 0.10 and obtain z = -1.282.
Solve t_1 = 68.0 - 1.282 * 5.0 to obtain 61.6 minutes (or 61.59).

teacher_walkthrough.text:

ai_rubric.observable: Identify cumulative probability P(T < t_2) = 0.80.
Look up Phi(z) = 0.80 to obtain z = 0.842 and set up (t_2 - 68.0) / 5.0 = 0.842.

parts.label: a
hints: The central 80% leaves $1 - 0.80 = 0.20$ in the two tails combined, so each tail has area $\frac{0.20}{2} = 0.10$.

Read $z$ for cumulative area $0.90$ from the critical values table.

walkthrough.text:

$$\text{Each tail} = \frac{1 - 0.80}{2} = 0.10 \implies \text{Cumulative probability} = 1 - 0.10 = 0.90$$

$$\Phi(z) = 0.90 \implies z = 1.282$$

ai_rubric.observable: Calculate tail area (1 - 0.80) / 2 = 0.10 and determine upper cumulative area 1 - 0.10 = 0.90.

parts.label: b
hints: Use the standard deviation $\sigma = 6.0$ and mean $\mu = 72.0$.
Calculate the lower boundary: $\mu - z\sigma = 72.0 - 1.282(6.0)$.
Calculate the upper boundary: $\mu + z\sigma = 72.0 + 1.282(6.0)$, and write down the interval.

walkthrough.text:
Calculate the lower interval boundary:
$$W_{\text{lower}} = 72.0 - 1.282 \times 6.0 = 72.0 - 7.692 = 64.308\text{ kg}$$

Calculate the upper interval boundary:
$$W_{\text{upper}} = 72.0 + 1.282 \times 6.0 = 72.0 + 7.692 = 79.692\text{ kg}$$

State the central 80% interval to 1 decimal place:
$$64.3\text{ kg} < W < 79.7\text{ kg}$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Compute the symmetric lower boundary below the mean:
$$72 - 1.282(6) = 64.308$$

Compute the symmetric upper boundary above the mean:
$$72 + 1.282(6) = 79.692$$

Format as an interval with units:
$$[64.3, 79.7]\text{ kg}$$

ai_rubric.observable: Calculate the lower boundary 72.0 - 1.282 * 6.0 = 64.308.
Calculate the upper boundary 72.0 + 1.282 * 6.0 = 79.692.

parts.label: a

parts.label: b
hints: Use the interval property: $\text{P}(k < L < 115.0) = \text{P}(L < 115.0) - \text{P}(L < k) = 0.30$.

Solve for the pin length $k$:
$$\frac{k - 100.0}{15.0} = 0.104 \implies k = 100.0 + 15.0 \times 0.104 = 101.56 \approx 101.6\text{ mm}$$

Calculate the boundary $k$:
$$k = 100 + 15(0.104) = 101.6\text{ mm}$$

parts.label: a
hints: A symmetric central region of 0.92 leaves $1 - 0.92 = 0.08$ in total outside.

teacher_walkthrough.text:

parts.label: a

walkthrough.text:
Standardise the boundary for Small fruit:

ai_rubric.observable: Add category probabilities: P(X < c) = 0.3085 + 0.35 = 0.6585.

parts.label: c
hints: The probability that a single fruit is Large is $p = 1 - \text{P}(X < c) = 1 - 0.6585 = 0.3415$.
Let $Y$ be the number of Large fruit in the sample of 6. Then $Y \sim \text{B}(6, 0.3415)$.
'Fewer than 2' means $Y = 0$ or $Y = 1$, so $\text{P}(Y < 2) = \text{P}(Y = 0) + \text{P}(Y = 1)$.
Calculate $\text{P}(Y = 0) = (0.6585)^6$ and $\text{P}(Y = 1) = 6(0.3415)(0.6585)^5$, then sum them.

walkthrough.text:
Determine the probability of an individual fruit being graded as Large and state the Binomial model:
$$p = 1 - 0.6585 = 0.3415, \quad Y \sim \text{B}(6, 0.3415)$$

Write down the cumulative binomial expression for fewer than 2:
$$\text{P}(Y < 2) = \text{P}(Y = 0) + \text{P}(Y = 1) = (0.6585)^6 + 6(0.3415)(0.6585)^5$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Identify the success probability and model as binomial:
$$p = 1 - 0.6585 = 0.3415, \quad Y \sim \text{B}(6, 0.3415)$$

Sum to give the final probability:
$$0.08182 + 0.25460 = 0.336$$

ai_rubric.observable: Identify probability of Large fruit p = 1 - 0.6585 = 0.3415 and define Y ~ B(6, 0.3415).
